title: Chapter 244 Preparing For The Battle Of Nanshan
content:
Chapter 244 Preparing For The Battle Of Nanshan

The relationship between them was originally a cooperative relationship, and there was no strict superior-subordinate relationship.

Lin Guanru needed the support of these gangs, so he tried his best to win over these gang leaders and was extremely tolerant of them.

Lin Guanru was still a little angry at first, but Ni Wu lost more than ten of his guards this time.

You know, his total number of guards is only 1,000, and every one of them is very precious.

But at this time, Ni Wu claimed to be in a humble position, which made Lin Guanru happy.

Although he lost this battle, he gained Ni Wu's superficial support, which has to be said to be a great joy.

Lin Guanru naturally likes rare talents like Ni Wu.

"Commander Ni, please get up quickly. Victory or defeat is a normal matter for military officers. Don't worry about it." Lin Guanru walked over quickly and helped Ni Wu up.

"I have heard a little bit about this Wang Shuo. He is a ruthless character. The person who can win the first place in Changping County is naturally not easy to conquer. We can conquer the other lords around Nanshanji first. There is no rush in this matter."

Lin Guanru was relieved and the two discussed for a long time before Ni Wucai left calmly.

When he reached the door, Ni Wu's expression changed and his eyes were cold.

"Humph, are you worthy of my allegiance?"

It turned out that he was just pretending to submit to Lin Guanru to avoid being deprived of his military power.

After Wang Shuo captured a large number of people from Iron Sword Sect, he was not too happy.

Because most of these people are unwilling to surrender.

They still have the illusion that their sect leader Ni Wu will definitely come to save them.

Among these three thousand people, there are at least more than 1,000 people who have such thoughts.

Wang Shuo did not want to execute them immediately. After all, they were only temporarily bewitched by Ni Wu.

Wang Shuo ordered people to expand the prison and imprison them all.

When they arrived at the prison, Wang Shuo made a special effort to have a friendly and cordial conversation with Gude.

After many days of persuasion, Gude finally relented and agreed that as long as Wang Shuo could defeat him, he would join Wana Village.

After hearing the news, Wang Shuo's face lit up with joy. It can be said that his strength has increased very quickly. It seems that the time to get another strong general will not be too short.

Although Ni Wu came to attack Wang Shuo, Wang Shuo was not impulsive and immediately raised his troops to attack Nanshanji.

At this time, the time is not yet ripe.

In the next few days, Wang Shuo handed over the 2,000 surrendered people to Baili Liang in compliance with everyone's wishes. Those who were willing to join the military were handed over to Baili Liang. Those who were unwilling were made to become ordinary citizens.

In the end, more than 1,600 people joined the army.

Drawing on the experience of fighting the horse bandits last time, Wang Shuo decided to build a new spear battalion and cooperate with the shield soldiers to form a solid military formation to fight against the opponent's cavalry troops.

At the same time, vigorously expand the cavalry force, which is the ace force of Wana Village.

Under the influence of the Loyal Soul Hall, more and more warriors have reached full loyalty.

Wang Shuo was very pleased.

Wang Shuo gave Ayub the responsibility for military-related matters.

He focused his main energy on making necromancy beads and practicing the "Black Dragon Sutra".

Before attacking Nanshanji, it is best to practice the "Black Dragon Sutra" for the first time, so that the combat effectiveness will be greatly improved.

The days pass quietly while everyone is busy!

On this day, Wang Shuo finally reached the first level of practicing the Black Dragon Sutra.
